method: Public measured sides -> learner-entered length relationships -> sums or fixed four equal sides.
invariants: Rhombus side and trapezoid upper side remain 2..20, and public side operands 1..20.

samples: 1600 samples per unit with at least 100 distinct public prompts. There remain 19 rhombus side values and 76 trapezoid side combinations, not 100 different shape facts or an authored bank.
limits: Normal UI evidence and tests are separate.
